oneOf.description: Name of a nested or subordinate container.

oneOf.description: Name assigned to a method that reads a field value.

oneOf.description: Name assigned to a method that writes a field value.

oneOf.title: Method parameter name
oneOf.description: Name assigned to a parameter in a method signature.
